sequencer.trackFormat: undeclared-length opcode stream at a per-voice track_base, decoded live until END, an unrecognized opcode byte, or a cursor past the top of MIA RAM
sequencer.trackBaseAfterReset: none: boot and reset forget every voice's track_base, and clear no MIA RAM
sequencer.startWithoutTrack: sequencerStart leaves a voice with no track_base stopped: no gate-off and no sequence-done IRQ

setBaseCommand.effect: sets track_base only; does not move cursor/note_index until the next sequencerLoad

sequencer.callerReservedRegions: track_base and its decoded bytes must avoid the video sync region, input/clock state, the audio register block, SD/FS state ($13000-$13BFF, see specs/storage.json), and any other voice's own track; the SDK does not allocate or check this
sequencer.durationUnit: 24 kHz sequencer ticks (tickRateHz; the header RATE field)

opcodes.name: NOTE
opcodes.effect: write FREQ_L/FREQ_H, gate off then on with phase reset so the envelope restarts from attack, last exactly dur ticks counting the decode tick (dur 0 lasts 1), advance note_index

opcodes.name: REST
opcodes.effect: gate off, last exactly dur ticks counting the decode tick (dur 0 lasts 1), advance note_index

opcodes.name: JUMP
opcodes.effect: set cursor to (address right after this record) + offset, a signed 24-bit little-endian self-relative value; does not advance note_index; used for looping instead of a dedicated LOOP opcode

opcodes.name: TIE
opcodes.effect: while the gate is up, write FREQ_L/FREQ_H only so the sounding note carries on without a new attack; with the voice released, or where catch-up resumes on it, act exactly like NOTE; last exactly dur ticks counting the decode tick (dur 0 lasts 1), advance note_index
